en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing an old European city street lined with brick townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart stands on the right side of the street. In the distance a tall church spire rises above the roofs. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the scene, and small publisher information appears at the lower left.
